storage: Airtight container at room temperature, away from damp and heat, about 6 to 12 months; keep out of direct sun.
looksLike: Tiny, short, pale grains that look like cumin seeds (jeera / seeragam), with a mild aroma. Sold as "seeraga samba", "jeera samba", "jeeraga samba" or "zeera samba".
howToPick: Look for small, uniform, short grains with a clean mild aroma and few broken pieces or stones. Avoid dusty, musty, discoloured or insect-infested bags.
shelfLife: Up to about a year in a sealed bag (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).
substitutes: Other short-grain aromatic rice (e.g. kalijira or gobindobhog)

usedIn.raw: 80 g raw rice per serving (6 tbsp)
